This '''unidentified mechanic''' settled on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] around [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. Having previously served the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], he restored several Imperial vessels and sold them to private owners. [[Snaplaunce]] purchased a disarmed [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle]] from him and named it ''[[Vote Snaplaunce]]''.
